instruction: Open Apple Notes and make a new note with the title "Book Quote", then set the body text to "A good reader is a rereader.".
reference_command:
cat > /tmp/memo_auto_add.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
file="$1"

cat > "$file" <<'TXT'
Book Quote

A good reader is a rereader.
TXT
EOF

chmod +x /tmp/memo_auto_add.sh
EDITOR=/tmp/memo_auto_add.sh memo notes --folder "Work" --add

parameters.note_content: A good reader is a rereader.
